title: The Best ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Backpacks for the School Year Ahead, Featuring 3D and Glow-In-The-Dark Designs
summary: HUNTR/X, the Saja Boys and Derpy and Sussie get their own styles.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Back to school is around the corner, and there are plenty of KPop Demon Hunters -themed school supplies available for fans getting ready for the new academic year. Although the Netflix movie came out over a year ago, the franchise shows no sign of slowing down its merch production. This month, the KPop Demon Hunters ramen noodle cup has been flying off the shelves, and the official HUNTR/X and Saja Boys light sticks are the No. 1 release on Amazon — all while the movie giant emerges with a newly released blind box for phone huggers . But when it comes to back-to-school supplies, backpacks are a standout.

The designs include glow-in-the-dark features, 3D character elements, embroidered accents and even matching three-piece sets. Whether you’re looking for a full-size backpack that fits laptops and textbooks or a collectible mini backpack inspired by HUNTR/X, Derpy or the Saja Boys, there are options for every type of fan. Many are officially licensed and feature practical details like padded shoulder straps, multiple storage compartments and water-resistant materials.

HUNTR/X BACKPACK

'KPop Demon Hunters' HUNTR/X Backpack

Officially licensed backpack.

This 18-inch backpack features a print of Rumi, Zoey and Mira with a 17.5-liter capacity. It includes a padded laptop sleeve, front zip compartments, two mesh bottle pockets, adjustable padded shoulder straps and a cushioned back panel. Available in purple and pink and white and pink for school or travel.

This set features a dedicated laptop compartment, reinforced stitching, smooth zippers, breathable back padding and wide S-shaped shoulder straps. The seller also offers backpacks featuring Rumi, Mira or Zoey individually.

The artwork features Rumi, Mira and Zoey, while the bag itself has a rubber-molded HUNTR/X charm, padded shoulder straps, a mesh back panel, laptop sleeve, front zip pocket and side mesh pockets. This bag is a popular option on Amazon, with more than 6,000 purchased this month.

Anime 'KPop Demon Hunters' HUNTR/X Backpack

Storage includes a 20-liter main compartment, padded laptop sleeve, front zip pocket and side mesh pockets. Adjustable padded straps and a mesh back panel provide comfort during long school hours. More than 2,000 were purchased on Amazon this month.

3D STYLE

The KPop Demon Hunters 16-inch backpack features Derpy’s embroidered face with 3D ears, a rubber molded logo, and a bamboo bag charm. Inspired by the lovable blue tiger from the Netflix animated movie, it offers a fun character design with practical functionality for school, travel or daily use.

This backpack features an all-over print of Derpy and Sussie with adjustable shoulder straps, side water bottle pockets and an interior laptop sleeve. Made from durable poly material, it measures 16.5 x 12 x 5 inches and is designed for everyday school use.

This backpack features an all-over chibi Saja Boys print, a front zip pocket, an interior laptop sleeve, and side water bottle pockets. Adjustable shoulder straps and durable materials make it suitable for carrying heavy school supplies.

This officially licensed mini backpack features iridescent 3D appliqués of Rumi, Mira and Zoey, plus the HUNTR/X logo inspired by a traditional Korean knot art. It includes adjustable straps, purple zips and charms, star details, a photo card charm with three character cards, a beaded charm and coordinating interior lining.

SAJA BOYS

'KPop Demon Hunters' Exclusive Saja Boys Mini Backpack

This Loungefly exclusive mini backpack highlights Jinu and the Saja Boys with pastel appliqués.

Decorated with a metal “Saja Boys” monogram and the band’s logo on a zipper charm, this mini bag also comes with adjustable shoulder straps, a sturdy top handle and coordinating interior lining to complete the design. The officially licensed bag measures 9 x 10.5 x 4.5 inches.

GLOW-IN-THE-DARK

'KPop Demon Hunters' Exclusive Derpy Light-Up Glow Mini Backpack

This sensory, 3D bag is full of interactive details.

Measuring 9 x 10.5 x 4.5 inches, this Loungefly exclusive mini backpack features glow-in-the-dark eyes, light-up piping, embroidered details and 3D elements that bring Derpy to life. It also includes filament whiskers, a movable potted plant in the side pockets (true fans will get this reference), an extending tongue, a Sussie bag charm and adjustable straps.

This 20 x 10.5 x 9-inch water-resistant duffle bag features colorful anime HUNTR/X artwork and a spacious interior for school, sports or weekend trips.
